module: Flowgraph node "Set Pursuit Mode" (once_instant). Sets the pursuit mode for a traffic vehicle: mode (0 off, 1 to 3 active, -1 arrested), targetId (default: player vehicle), policeId (default: all police). Does nothing if traffic is not 'on'; inserts the target into traffic if absent.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays "Traffic not active!" if traffic is not active.

workOnce.desc: If traffic is 'on', inserts the target into traffic if needed then calls gameplay_police.setPursuitMode(mode, vehId, policeId).
